statements.status_notes: libthrift@0.9.3 is shaded inside the druid-ranger-security extension fat-JAR via ranger-plugins-common. CVE-2019-0210 describes a Go server panic - Druid is a Java application with no Go server component, so the vulnerable code path is not exercisable. Fix requires upstream Apache Ranger to update its bundled libthrift to >= 0.13.0. Monitor apache/ranger upstream.
